htdemucs.description: Hybrid Transformer Demucs — 4 stems, best balance of speed and quality

htdemucs_ft.description: htdemucs fine-tuned — 4 stems, highest quality, ~4x slower (CUDA-only at usable speed)

htdemucs_6s.description: htdemucs 6-stem variant — adds guitar and piano tracks (experimental)

mdx_extra.description: MDX-Net extra — 4 stems, strong on vocal isolation, MUSDB-trained

pedalboard-chain.description: Pedalboard DSP mastering chain — preset-based EQ + compression + limiting (pedalboard 0.9.20, GPL v3)

librosa-analyze.description: librosa MIR analysis — BPM, key, loudness, duration, spectral features (librosa 0.10.2, ISC)

sox-transform.description: SoX-based DSP transform chain — gain, EQ, compressor, reverb, pitch, tempo (pysox 1.4.1, BSD-3-Clause)

fx-chain.description: Generic effects chain — full pedalboard catalog (Compressor, Reverb, Chorus, Delay, Distortion, PitchShift, filters, ...) as an ordered chain of {type, params}

midi-compose.description: JSON-to-MIDI transcoder — emit a Standard MIDI File from a tracks+notes spec (mido 1.3.3, MIT)

midi-render.description: MIDI-to-audio synthesis via fluidsynth + FluidR3_GM SoundFont (GM patches 0–127 plus drum kit on channel 10)
